balanced_accuracy_policy: Report only when every declared true class is present in the evaluated subset; otherwise null with missing-class reason
execution_order: Global SHA256 rank of domain/seed/dataset/row ID/arm; independent fresh requests, no shared conversation
existing_direct_jev: Context only: historical direct prompts are not the exact no-proposal control
funding: Not established by preparation. Existing numeric/text allocations remain protected; new runner must enforce an independently frozen allocation inside the existing cumulative authorization
future_fresh_numeric_study: Separate larger and fresh holdout experiment, not included here
multiplicity: Exploratory unadjusted intervals; no confirmatory significance claims
primary_analysis: Per-dataset paired accuracy and macro-F1 differences; normalized-text group bootstrap; fixed/harmed and failure decomposition
prompt_difference: Only the JSON proposal-slot value changes; identical wording, input, examples and choices
selection: SHA256 rank of domain/seed/dataset/opaque row ID; no labels, text or source predictions inspected

serving_repeat_control.analysis: Report paired label agreement/disagreement and success/failure combinations on all selected repeats; no independent-architecture interpretation
serving_repeat_control.order_note: Named repeat and reference are independently interleaved; repeat is not required to occur later in wall-clock order
serving_repeat_control.purpose: Separate serving-repeatability diagnostic, not a third primary value contrast
serving_repeat_control.selection: Independent SHA256 rank of domain/seed/dataset/case ID, without labels or outcomes

shuffle: SHA256-ranked single-cycle derangement within selected rows; proposal frequencies preserved; same labels may remain
